offering_description.value: Supplies aircraft parts, repair and overhaul services, and supply chain solutions to commercial airlines, cargo operators and government aircraft fleets. Also makes expeditionary mobility products such as shelters and containers for military customers. Sells mainly through direct contracts and its own repair facilities.

primary_products.value: aircraft components; landing gear; expeditionary shelters; military containers

primary_services.value: aircraft maintenance and repair; component overhaul; integrated supply chain management; aircraft modification

customer_segment.value: B2B: airlines, cargo carriers, aircraft lessors and maintenance providers; B2G: US and allied military and government agencies

end_markets.value: commercial aviation; defense and government; air cargo

revenue_model.value: product sales: aircraft parts and military shelters sold to customers; service fees: repair, overhaul and maintenance work on aircraft components; project or contract: long-term government and military supply and maintenance contracts
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: service provider: maintenance, repair and supply chain services sold to airlines and operators; OEM / manufacturer: expeditionary shelters and containers built for military customers; distributor: aircraft parts sold from inventory to commercial and government operators

geography_served.value: global: customers worldwide, with repair facilities in the US and several other countries

specialization.value: related lines: aviation aftermarket parts and services, expeditionary mobility products for military customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: airline, cargo and government accounts managed by sales teams; own locations: company-owned repair, overhaul and distribution facilities

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: FAA and EASA repair station approvals, defense procurement and export control rules
